description: A shell script containing tests for Git commands outside a repository, including setup, patch application, diff, grep, and other Git operations, with specific focus on non-repo environments.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global Git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in files or output.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
